items.question: What additional trees and animals are associated with the eastern land?
premises: The eastern land is characterized by specific flora.
Aṅkola trees and other trees are included among its flora.
Cats and mongooses are included among its fauna.
items.inference: The eastern land is further identified by the presence of aṅkola and other trees, as well as cats and mongooses.
items.plain_english: The eastern land is also associated with aṅkola trees and other trees, and likewise with cats and mongooses.
